Dosage form(s): This monograph excludes foods or food-like dosage forms as indicated in the Compendium of Monographs Guidance Document.
Acceptable dosage forms for oral use are indicated in the dosage form drop-down list of the web-based Product Licence Application form for Compendial applications.
Use(s) or Purpose(s): Helps support cognitive/brain health/function (Schreiber et al. 2000; Cenacchi et al. 1993; Crook et al. 1992; Engel et al. 1992; Crook et al. 1991; Maggioni et al. 1990).
Quantity(ies): 300 milligrams of Phosphatidylserine, per day (Schreiber et al. 2000; Cenacchi et al. 1993; Crook et al. 1992; Engel et al. 1992; Crook et al. 1991; Maggioni et al. 1990).
